title: Ancient ape fossil in Egypt could rewrite the story of human origins
caption:
A newly found ape jaw from Egypt pushes the birthplace of our ancient relatives northward. The fossil challenges the long‑standing East‑Africa view and shows how a single jaw can reshape our family tree. More discoveries in North Africa could rewrite the story of human evolution.

Source: Sciencedaily - Ancient ape fossil in Egypt could rewrite the story of human origins

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261031011638.htm
